summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (card P12) evaluating whether BID (BH3-interacting domain death agonist) loss-of-function abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell killing at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill. The document is a pre-registered hypothesis/assay proposal with a NEGATIVE status label, meaning the key experimental comparison (matched BID LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish) is currently UNKNOWN and has not been run. All supporting evidence is drawn from literature, and no original experimental data is presented.

Related prior: P5–P11 (Bax/apoptosome/caspase-8/caspase-3 ≠ BID BH3-linker gate proof). Document date: 2026-09-26.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis
content_blocks.content: On a matched senescent culture, BID (BH3-interacting domain death agonist) loss-of-function (or BID BH3-block) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill. Pre-registered criterion: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, with each arm showing a pre-registered ≥20% relative kill loss vs the same senolytic on control genotype/vehicle.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Why It Matters
content_blocks.content: BID is the BH3 linker / mitochondrial-amplification node downstream of Bax (P7/P8), apoptosome/caspase-9 (P9), caspase-8 (P10), and caspase-3 (P11). If BID block abolishes FOXO4-DRI ≥ navitoclax, extrinsic→MOMP amplification is shared between the two senolytics. If FOXO4-DRI survives BID LOF while navitoclax falls, FOXO4-DRI retains BID-sparing routes. Soft-claims: FOXO4-DRI∩BID LOF/epistasis/navitoclax H2H soft-complete = 0; sole related FOXO4-DRI apoptosis hit is PMID 41625068 (cascade framing only); matched BID H2H remains UNKNOWN. P5–P11 are explicitly stated to NOT prove this BID gate; P5 HN–Bid biophysics ≠ FOXO4-DRI∩BID LOF H2H.

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax acts via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w inhibition. Both may require BID as the BH3 linker into MOMP, or FOXO4-DRI may be partially BID-independent while navitoclax is abolished (or the reverse). Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work frames a p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade without a BID LOF vs navitoclax matched abolish panel. Bid-deficient mice resist Fas-induced hepatocellular apoptosis (Yin 1999) — this is an extrinsic→MOMP linker prior, not a FOXO4-DRI SC H2H. The ≥ equal abolish criterion is stronger than 'both can use BH3 linkers,' and is distinct from Bax/apoptosome/caspase-8/caspase-3 necessity.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 28340339 / DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2017.02.031 / PMC5556182 — Baar 2017: FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 → senescent-cell apoptosis; not Bcl-xL occupancy; no BID LOF arm.
2. PMID 41625068 / DOI 10.3389/fbioe.2025.1729166 / PMC12852416 — 2025: Endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3; cascade ≠ BID LOF vs navitoclax H2H.
3. PMID 26711051 / DOI 10.1111/acel.12445 / PMC4854923 — Zhu 2016: Navitoclax senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted.
4. PMID 10476969 / DOI 10.1038/23730 — Yin 1999: Bid-deficient mice resist Fas-induced hepatocellular apoptosis; extrinsic→MOMP linker prior, not FOXO4-DRI SC matched panel.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Evidence Status
content_blocks.content:
- FOXO4–p53 entry: LITERATURE (PMID 28340339)
- Downstream BCL-2/caspase-3 framing: LITERATURE without BID LOF H2H (PMID 41625068)
- Navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic: LITERATURE (PMID 26711051)
- Bid-deficient Fas-hepatocyte resistance: LITERATURE as extrinsic→MOMP prior (PMID 10476969)
- Matched BID LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish: UNKNOWN (soft-complete FOXO4-DRI∩BID∩(LOF|epistasis|navitoclax) = 0; sole related FOXO4-DRI apoptosis hit = 41625068 cascade)
- ≥ Equal abolish (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav; each ≥20% relative): PREDICTION
- P5–P11 do not already prove this epistasis — P5 HN–Bid is pathway-sparing biophysics, not this H2H.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P5–P11 as proving P12 — Bax/residual/apoptosome/caspase-8/caspase-3 cards did not run BID LOF; empty soft-complete ≠ demonstrated ≥ equal abolish; P5 HN–Bid ≠ FOXO4-DRI∩BID LOF.
2. Caspase-3 cascade ≠ BID necessity — PMID 41625068 implicates p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 without genetic BID requirement or navitoclax-matched abolish.
3. Yin ≠ FOXO4-DRI panel — classical Fas→MOMP prior is not a senolytic H2H; ≥ equal abolish is stronger than shared BH3-linker language; navitoclax-insensitive SC types confound matched culture choice.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Method / Assay Design
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Required elements: (1) Lock one senescent system sensitive to both senolytics; (2) BID LOF vs BID BH3-block tool; (3) Viability + MOMP/caspase readout. Comparison: FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax under BID LOF or BID BH3-block vs control genotype/vehicle on the same matched senescent culture. Pre-registered threshold: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax AND each arm ≥20% relative kill loss. Falsifier: FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives BID LOF while navitoclax kill is abolished, or relative kill loss_FOXO4 < relative kill loss_navitoclax outside the pre-registered ≥ equal band.

content_blocks.title: Ablation / Critical Dependencies
content_blocks.content:
Three critical dependencies identified:
1. Matched BID LOF (or BID BH3-block) contrast of FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax on the same culture — without this H2H abolish panel, separate LITERATURE legs cannot show FOXO4-DRI kill is abolished ≥ navitoclax under BID LOF.
2. ≥ Equal-abolish quantitative contrast (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav) — showing both can use BH3 linkers is weaker than the claim; FOXO4-DRI could retain partial BID-independent routes while still 'using apoptosis.'
3. P5–P11≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠abolish + cascade-framing≠BID-necessity + P5-HN–Bid≠H2H discipline — treating P7–P11 Bax/apoptosome/caspase framing or empty PubMed or 41625068 cascade or P5 HN–Bid biophysics as already deciding BID epistasis would invent a LOF result left UNKNOWN.

key_findings: The key experimental comparison — matched BID LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish on the same senescent culture — is UNKNOWN and has NOT been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN).

Soft-complete for FOXO4-DRI∩BID∩(LOF|epistasis|navitoclax) = 0; the sole related FOXO4-DRI apoptosis hit is PMID 41625068, which provides cascade framing only (p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3) without BID LOF or navitoclax H2H.

All supporting evidence is literature-derived: FOXO4-DRI mechanism via FOXO4–p53 (Baar 2017, PMID 28340339); navitoclax senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w (Zhu 2016, PMID 26711051); Bid-deficient mice resist Fas-induced hepatocellular apoptosis (Yin 1999, PMID 10476969).
Pre-registered claim requires: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax AND each arm ≥20% relative kill loss vs control genotype/vehicle on matched senescent culture.
Competing/falsifier outcome: FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives BID LOF while navitoclax kill is abolished — indicating BID-sparing FOXO4-DRI execution routes.
P5–P11 (Bax/apoptosome/caspase-8/caspase-3 cards) explicitly do NOT prove P12; P5 HN–Bid biophysics ≠ FOXO4-DRI∩BID LOF H2H.
Document status is NEGATIVE (polarity: negative), reflecting that the hypothesis is unproven and the required experiment has not been conducted.
Kill cost tier = 1 (low cost); estimated time to refute = 4 weeks, suggesting this is a tractable near-term experiment.
FTO status is UNKNOWN; IP class is momp-execution-gate.
